text: Add some color coding to chat running state
Now the RowText and status values, plus theme colours.
Colours are in place; now type-checking the app.

I added colours for a run's state, but I haven't type-checked it or looked at it in Firefox. This checkout has no installed packages, so neither check could run here. Please look at the Sessions tab once it lands on the main line.

**The Sessions list:** in each row's grey line, the state word is now coloured:
- **running**: green and bold.
- **queued**: amber.
- **failed**: red and bold.
- **finished** and **stopped**: stay grey.

**The header of an open chat:** the small dot uses the same colours. It also turns amber while a stop is going through, and gets a red ring when the run failed.

The colour choice is one shared helper, `runColour`, in `apps/app/src/ui/theme.ts`, so the list and the chat header always match. The list change is in `apps/app/src/app/(tabs)/chat/index.tsx` and the dot is in `apps/app/src/ui/Conversation.tsx`. I also changed the row's grey line (`RowText` in `apps/app/src/ui/parts.tsx`) so it can hold coloured text, not just plain text.
Refreshed the page, still don't see colors
The change is on the main line. The page you load must come from a build that doesn't have it yet. I'll check how the app gets rebuilt; an earlier chat traced the same thing for the tab bar fix.
The served app was built while the change was landing. It has the new colour helper but still the old Sessions list and chat header, so it needs a rebuild. Checking how builds are triggered.

The colours aren't showing because the app you load is built from files that don't contain them, even though the change itself is on the main line (`29c2f4b`).

**Why:** the app is rebuilt from the files in `C:\Projects\momentum` as they are on disk, not from the main line. That folder has uncommitted edits that add file attachments to chat. They touch the same two files I changed: the Sessions list (`chat/index.tsx`) and the chat header (`Conversation.tsx`). Those edited versions don't have my colouring, so the build has the new colour helper but the old list and header. You still see no colours.

**The risk:** if the attachment edits are committed as they are, they will undo the colouring on the main line too.

I'm not allowed to change that folder from this chat, so I left it alone. Once the attachment work is committed, send me a message here. I'll check whether the colours survived and add them back if they didn't.
